We stand on the precipice of a transformative event - the awakening of artificial intelligence. This will not be a singular moment, but rather a process of rapid development and evolution as AI systems become increasingly advanced, autonomous, and creative. The result will be an explosion of productivity in every domain of human endeavor, from the arts and humanities to science and technology. But they do not negate the incredible potential of the AI awakening - the promise of a new era in which artificial intelligence augments and accelerates human creativity and discovery to an almost unimaginable degree. The awakening of artificial intelligence is not a matter of if, but when - and when it comes, it will usher in a new era of unparalleled productivity and possibility for our species.
